PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: guide-frame-last-frame-dawn-after-victory-variation-1
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Guide-frame guard: the screenplay beat and this row determine camera position, lens, blocking, composition, and action. References may influence only grade, exposure, atmosphere, texture, and production-value feel.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain; explicitly requested golden luminous-VFX behavior only.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
LAST FRAME - DAWN AFTER VICTORY — VARIATION 1: CINEMATIC COMPOSITION, STORY STATE, AND SHOT-CONTINUITY GUIDE.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Cinematic epic closing narrative frame, EXT. EARTH - DESERT - DAWN, the final restored landscape after the Harrowing of Hell is complete. Ultra-wide establishing still in true 2.39:1 anamorphic widescreen: an ancient Near Eastern wilderness at the first breath of morning, the exact geographic counterpart of the earlier desert-night fissure opening, now peaceful and sealed. The camera is a slightly elevated wide master on a virtual 24mm to 28mm anamorphic lens, horizon set on the lower third so the sky carries most of the emotional weight, deep layered depth of field so dunes, midground stone, and far ridgelines all read cleanly, gentle optical falloff and subtle anamorphic oval bokeh on distant highlights only.

Subject and geography: a vast desert basin of pale sand, wind-rippled dunes, scattered low scrub of drought-hardy thorn and sparse dry grass, weathered limestone outcrops and dark basalt boulders half-buried in grit. In the midground center, the former vertical wound in the earth—the same roughly forty-foot-diameter fissure that once opened as a purposeful shaft into darkness—is fully sealed. The ground there is freshly quiet, the sand and crushed stone knitted closed into a continuous surface. A faint circular or elongated scar of slightly darker, denser soil and fine mineral dust marks where the shaft once split the crust, not a crater of violence but a healed seam, as if the earth itself has accepted peace. No open pit, no glowing abyss, no remaining doorway into hell—only restored land.

A final residual of the harrowing remains as pure light memory rather than open wound: a soft, almost invisible warm radiance bleeds faintly from micro-cracks and pores in the sealed seam for a last moment of triumph, golden-white and clean, already dying into ordinary dawn. Tiny motes of illuminated dust hang low over the scar like incense settling after a liturgy. The surrounding desert shows no modern tracks, no vehicles, no structures, no poles, no fences—only timeless wilderness under a sky that has finished holding its breath.

Sky and light arc (master color beat for dawn ending): the upper frame still carries deep night ink and bruised indigo-black at the zenith, transitioning through royal purple and soft violet into rose-lavender, then into a brilliant gold and warm amber band along the horizon. The sun itself is either just below the ridge or kissing the far horizon as a low brilliant disc of molten gold, casting long raking rays across the dunes. Color temperature of the principal daylight key is warm natural morning light near 4500K, with richer amber and soft gold in the low atmosphere, replacing every cold blue and obsidian black of the hell sequence. Thin high cirrus and delicate desert haze catch the sunrise, creating layered god-ray streaks that feel natural and physical, not fantasy CGI beams. Stars have almost all withdrawn; only the faintest cold pinpoints remain high in the remaining night vault, fading as day claims the world.

Hero focal action: a single pure white dove, mid-flight, rising from the midground sealed seam into the new light. The bird is anatomically correct, real-world rock-dove or pure white domestic dove proportions, wings fully extended in a strong upward climb, feathers catching warm rim light on the leading edges and soft gold fill on the breast. Subtle motion clarity freezes the wing primaries so each feather structure reads; no cartoon silhouette, no oversized symbolic prop bird. The dove is the sole living hero subject in frame—no humans, no procession, no Jesus figure visible—because this is the earth-side aftermath: victory already achieved below, freedom announced by the ascending bird alone. Position the dove slightly off-center toward the golden light so the eye travels from sealed earth to bird to sun, a clear visual sentence of resurrection, peace, and release.

Texture and atmosphere: fine airborne dust and pollen in the low morning air; soft volumetric haze thickening toward the sun; cool blue-gray shadow still pooling in dune troughs while dune crests blaze warm; faint moisture sheen on cooler stone faces where night chill lingers; sand grains individually readable in the near midground; quiet stillness after catastrophe, wind almost calm. Color grade is warm golden amber replacing the project’s cold blues and blacks—horizon gold (#FFD700 to soft #FFBF00 amber), upper sky purple-to-ink, ground tones of sand beige, dusty rose, and soft ochre, with the sealed scar a slightly cooler mineral gray that still accepts warm bounce light. Subtle filmic contrast, gentle highlight roll-off on the sun disk, deep but not crushed shadow detail, photoreal live-action biblical epic production still—not illustration, not anime, not stylized CGI cartoon.

Emotional continuity lock: this image is the narrative last frame of SEQ-16 desert dawn—fissure sealed, final light spill resolved into peace, single white dove rising, chorus of victory implied but not visualized as text or graphics. It pairs against the opening desert-night frame (bruised purple-black sky, open vertical wound, cold starlight). Geography, dune language, and rock types must feel continuous with that night plate; only time of day, light temperature, fissure state, and the dove differ. Sacred reverent tone of restored creation; no gore, no residual hell architecture, no guardians, no chains, no iron-and-bone gate fragments, no modern objects, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, no UI, no title typography in this still (title card is a separate graphic asset). No second faces or rear faces on any creature; the dove has only natural avian anatomy. Keep the sealed earth peaceful and smooth, the sky a true black-to-purple-to-brilliant-gold gradient, and the single white dove flying upward into new light as the unmistakable closing emblem of victory over darkness.
